_note: Tier 2, oldest end. The 30 April 2025 Pearl Harbor and judgment session.

mentions.claim_text: He says he was shown a Pearl Harbor event in the days ahead, with China and North Korea becoming desperate to get out from under the Western boot.
mentions.quote: a Pearl Harbor event as we see in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: A surprise attack on American forces by China or North Korea.

mentions.claim_text: He describes the structure as a mafia arrangement in which China is the godfather and North Korea is the hitman who carries out the act.
mentions.quote: China was the godfather. And North Korea was the hitman
mentions.falsify_match: North Korea acting against America at Chinese direction.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. The division of roles is specific enough to be wrong, which is what makes it worth keeping.

mentions.claim_text: He says he kept hearing remember Pearl Harbor in prayer, noted that Japan carried out the original, and reports being told this will be a type and shadow in the days ahead, with one party set up to look like the bad guy.
mentions.quote: This will be a type and shadow in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: A surprise attack that parallels Pearl Harbor in form.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Type and shadow is a loosening device: it means the parallel need not be exact, so almost any surprise attack would fit.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw Asian cultures holding to their own values and family ties and preserving what they believe, comparing cultural difference to that between African American and white American culture.
mentions.quote: I saw the Asians sticking with the Asian culture
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: an observation about culture with no event attached.

mentions.claim_text: He says Asian nations come together to combat Western culture, that he kept hearing Pearl Harbor echoing as a retaliation, and that he was then shown Canada and the scales.
mentions.quote: together to combat the Western culture
mentions.falsify_match: An Asian bloc forming explicitly against Western influence.
mentions.falsify_miss: None forms. Undated, and the framing as retaliation is not tied to any particular provocation.

mentions.claim_text: He says a new virus worse than AIDS is coming on the scene, and that he saw judgment begin in Japan over trafficking coming up from Mexico and over what is done to children.
mentions.quote: Worse than kind of an AIDS virus. This is a new virus
mentions.falsify_match: A new sexually transmitted disease more severe than HIV emerging.
mentions.falsify_miss: None emerges. Undated. The comparison to AIDS sets a severity, which is more than most of the health material offers.

mentions.claim_text: He says judgment is coming and the cup of sin is full, answers the objection that people have not seen such a thing before by pointing to God's grace, and ties the judgment to harm done to children.
mentions.quote: The cup of sin is full
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: a full cup of sin has no measure and no date.

mentions.claim_text: He says judgment is beginning rather than far off, and that in the spirit realm it sounded like thunder shaking.
mentions.quote: judgment is beginning. It wasn't like, oh, it's far off
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: judgment beginning has no threshold, and stating it is already under way removes the deadline.

mentions.claim_text: He says millions of angels were coming to protect and help on a scale beyond comprehension, and that he saw a window in which even North Korea will be reached and many in the heart of China will hear the gospel, with a great shaking coming.
mentions.quote: even North Korea will be reached or have an opportunity
mentions.falsify_match: Open gospel access in North Korea and interior China.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Undated, and the window is described without a start or an end.

mentions.claim_text: He says millions of people in Canada are about to go to hell because they voted wrong, and that there must be righteous men and women there with a backbone like a crowbar ready to be used.
mentions.quote: there is millions of people that are about to go to hell in Canada
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: an assertion about the eternal fate of voters, tied to an election result two days earlier.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls the covid trucker protests and the freezing of bank accounts in Canada, and says there will be the same kind of outcry again with people saying they want to leave.
mentions.quote: There'll be an outcry. There'll be people saying we want to leave
mentions.falsify_match: Mass protest in Canada on the scale of the 2022 convoy, with secession sentiment.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The convoy is the template rather than a forecast, and Alberta separation polling was already a running story.

mentions.claim_text: He says there are release points under the soil, not only on the ocean floor but where civilisation is, and names Alaska and Yellowstone as a danger zone.
mentions.quote: I saw Alaska. I saw Yellowstone, Yellowstone, Danger Zone
mentions.falsify_match: Significant volcanic or seismic activity at Yellowstone or in Alaska.
mentions.falsify_miss: None beyond the ordinary. Yellowstone records thousands of small quakes a year, so only an eruption or a major event would count.

mentions.claim_text: In the middle of the prayer stream he says he is seeing Germany, with nothing attached.
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a place name with nothing attached to it.

mentions.claim_text: He says their tongues are going around the Second World War, that he sees France and Germany standing still, and reports being told to camp here.
mentions.quote: I see France and Germany and they're standing still
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: two countries standing still, with no act or date.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees Ukraine and a bundle like hay or grains of wheat tied with a white cloth, pointing towards France.
mentions.quote: It looks like grains of wheat in a bundle pointing towards France
mentions.falsify_match: Ukrainian grain becoming a decisive issue between Ukraine and France.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. He offers no interpretation, so the image would have to be matched to an event after the fact.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees filleted fish with pink meat in Ukraine, calls it strange, and offers no interpretation.
mentions.quote: I see fish that are filleted like for eating in Ukraine
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: an uninterpreted image.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees Russia provoked, running through to North Korea, with China like two brothers behind it, and North Korea, China and Iran all together.
mentions.quote: I see Russia provoked. And it goes clear into North Korea
mentions.falsify_match: A formal alignment of Russia, China, North Korea and Iran against the West.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such alignment. Note the four were already routinely grouped together in Western threat assessments when this was given.
